messages:
violet: opening PR to update SDK snippets: streaming yields deltas now, paginate param renamed to cursor, and add a small retry helper. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4278

sam: thanks. Can you make the Python example show assembling partial chunks (so users don't expect a full response)?

violet: yep. plan: async iterator example + a short sync blocking wrapper for users on sync stacks.

chris: for Go pls include context timeout/cancel in the stream sample or tests leak. Example should show handling io.EOF and transient errors separately.

ben: I'll add a tiny exponential backoff snippet under "Advanced patterns" for 5xx during streaming. Keep it language-agnostic but include a concrete ts/py example.

sam: TS note: for-await requires Node >=10? actually proper support for for-await-of on streams needs Node 12+. Add a comment.

violet: quick snippets to land:```py
buf=[]
async for ev in client.stream(req):
  if ev.type=="delta":
    buf.append(ev.text)
result = "".join(buf)
```
```ts
let buf = ''
for await (const ev of client.stream(req)) {
  if (ev.type === 'delta') buf += ev.text
}
```
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 20*time.Second)
defer cancel()
stream, _ := client.Stream(ctx, req)
for {
  ev, err := stream.Recv()
  if err == io.EOF { break }
  if transient(err) { /* backoff */ }
  // handle ev
}
```

chris: looks good. one nit: Go sample should import context/time/io and check err != nil before inspecting ev. I'll push a micro-fix.

ben: added backoff examples and a short line about batching increasing 99th percentile latency. Pushed to PR.

deploy-bot: CI queued for docs#4278: examples-lint / docs-build / examples-sanity.

violet: can someone verify the paginate samples use cursor not page_token? I renamed the param in the API but may have missed a helper.

sam: confirmed py+ts switched to cursor. chris will patch Go helper.

chris: fixed Go helper and pushed.

violet: great. once CI is green I'll merge and add a short migration note in breaking-changes.md explaining stream iterator + cursor rename. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
